'''turvla''' are words that have internal structure (like prefixes, infixes, suffixes) and the meaning of which depends on this structure. '''turjvo''' are [[lujvo]] that are '''turvla'''.

===turvla classes===
If for a given word you find more places than listed here it means this word is not a turvla.

# '''-gau''' suffix. '''x1 x2 x3 x4 ... brodygau''' unwraps into '''x1 cu gasnu lo nu x2 broda x3 x4 ...'''. Equivalent to '''x1 jai gau broda fai x2 x3 x4 ...'''
# '''-ske''' suffix. '''brodyske''' = ''x1 is the broda science, broda-ology studying particular subject x2''
# '''-pre''' suffix. '''brodypre''' means ''x1 is a brodaman, a broda-er''. Roughly corresponds to English "-er" or "-man" like "fireman" etc. Can describe only persons, not non-conscious objects.
# '''-sku''' suffix. '''brodysku''' = ''x1 says x2 (text related to broda) towards x3''. '''piksku''' means ''to say comment'', '''retsku''' means ''to ask (say question)'' ...
# '''cmacma''', '''brabra''' mean ''very small'', ''very big''. Unwrap according to [[la tsani|La Tsani]]'s Flipping Principle.
# '''bra-''' prefix. '''brabroda''' - ''something like broda and metaphorically big''. The place structure is identical to '''broda'''. '''bramlatu''' is ''Big Cat'', not ''big cat''. '''braxamsi''' is described by some not just as a ''big xamsi'' but having some new properties.
# '''cma-''' prefix generates cimjvo.
# '''tce-''' prefix. '''tcebroda''' unwraps into '''mutce lo ka ce'u broda'''
# '''zan-''' prefix is applied to the whole lujvo part after it, doesn't need '''kem''' after it. Marks the tail as something favorable, nice, cool.
# '''mal-''' prefix is applied to the whole lujvo part after it, doesn't need '''kem''' after it. Marks the tail as something bad, deplorable, shitty.
# '''zil-''' prefix. '''zilbroda''' unwraps into '''zi'o cu broda'''
# '''-nmo''' suffix to attitudinal words. '''uinmo''' means ''to be happy''.
# '''-cmi''' suffix. '''brodycmi''' is ''x1 is a member of group x2''
# '''-kansa''' suffix. '''brodykansa''' is ''x1 is a co-worker, colleague, workmate, corelegionist (brother in faith), coeval, fellow contryman/traveller etc. of x2 in '''lo nu broda'''''
# '''-sle''' suffix. '''brodysle''' is ''x1 is a cell, particle of x2''
# '''sim-''' prefix. '''x1 ce x2 x3 x4 simbroda''' expands into '''x1 ce x2 simxu lo ka ce'u broda ce'u x3 x4'''
#* [[User:Cirko|la cirko]]: Why not use '''-si'u''' for this? '''sim-''' has been used similarly to '''zma-''' and '''trajy-''', to show that not the x1, but some other place, fits in {{jvs|simxu}}1/{{jvs|zmadu}}1/{{jvs|traji}}1.
#** [[la gleki]]: {{jvs|simbi'o}}, {{jvs|simda'a}}, {{jvs|simbasti}} are in la jbovlaste.
==lo seltau that are adverbial==
* certain prefixes work as adverbs. i.e. in a lujvo with two {{jvs|selbrisle}} they dont take the position of x2 of the tertau.
** Example: '''tce-''' prefix. In '''tcebroda''' in instead puts '''broda''' into x2 of '''mutce''' in expansion.
** See also [[selskiski]].
** [https://groups.google.com/d/msg/lojban/Fu4L7pr04gg/aitwQSBBKGgJ Cyril Slobin and Russian community] noted the same. {{vlapoi|lo|pofygau}} could be allegedly expanded into '''lo gasnu je spofu''' or '''lo gasnu poi spofu''' but in turjvo ideology this doesn't happen since '''-gau''' is a suffix having a fixed meaning.
==Some commonly used terms==
*lujvo - a verb formally consisting of rafsi according to Lojban morphology.
**turjvo - a lujvo that has rafsi taking certain positions (slots) in the lujvo with fixed effect.
***jvajvo - a lujvo that can be unwrapped into a bridi according to rules of its consisting slotted rafsi ('''brodygau''').
***cimjvo - a lujvo the meaning (+ sometimes place structure) of which is unpredictable from its constituent rafsi ('''brabroda''').
